verified_conclusion: All 30 verified titles form 15 exact rep1/rep2 pairs from 15 donors. Treating these as 30 independent samples doubles the apparent sample size.

consequence: A case-control contrast fitted on 63 arrays instead of <=32 donors has inflated residual degrees of freedom, understated standard errors and anti-conservative p values. Combined with no FDR correction, this alone can manufacture most of the reported DEG list.
